summary: Resolve ticket reservations from dynamic registries

delivery.outcome: Ticket allocation resolves lifecycle and workstream vocabulary from the current governance registry instead of hardcoded shell values
nonGoals: Do not persist protected merge receipts in the repository tree
Do not infer merge authority from ticket Markdown
Do not change governance checker ticket attribution
Do not publish a release in this ticket

architecture.decision: Resolve one manifest registry, validate its closed lifecycle/workstream projections, and make allocation fail closed when that registry is unavailable or malformed
interfaceChanges: new-ticket.sh rejects workstreams not declared by the resolved governance manifest
architecture.rollback: Revert the allocator and its regression test before adoption; existing ticket data remains unchanged

validation.evidence: bounded command output and exact-head CI receipt
